en.sub-title: Integrated Carbon Emission Calculation for LLM Training, Inference, and Hardware Lifecycle
en.lca-lifespan-tooltip: The typical operational life of an AI chip in a data center or server environment, usually 5 years.
en.lca-utilization-tooltip: The average time an AI chip spends on training or inference tasks per day. The recommended value is 24 hours.
en.lca-carbon-intensity-tooltip: The amount of carbon emissions produced per kilowatt-hour of electricity generated. The 2022 average for Taiwan is approx. 0.416 kgCO₂e/kWh.
en.lca-total-co2-tooltip: Total greenhouse gas emissions produced by the chip throughout its lifecycle, including manufacturing and operation.
en.lca-water-tooltip: Total water consumed during the manufacturing and operational phases of the chip's lifespan.
en.lca-ewaste-tooltip: The weight of waste generated by the chip at the end of its life, usually referring to the product's own weight.
en.lca-op-co2-tooltip: Carbon emissions generated from electricity consumption during the chip's operation.
en.lca-em-co2-tooltip: Carbon emissions generated during the chip's manufacturing, transportation, and disposal phases.
en.training-total-params-tooltip: The total number of parameters in the model, in billions (B).
en.training-base-params-tooltip: For MoE models, the number of parameters in the corresponding dense base model.
en.training-tokens-tooltip: The total number of tokens processed by the model during training or inference, in billions (B).
en.training-power-tooltip: The average total power consumption per compute device, including host, memory, etc.
en.training-efficiency-tooltip: The percentage of actual computational throughput relative to the theoretical peak throughput.
en.training-pue-tooltip: Power Usage Effectiveness. The ratio of total data center energy consumption to IT equipment energy consumption. The closer to 1, the higher the efficiency.
en.training-ci-tooltip: The kilograms of carbon dioxide equivalent produced per kilowatt-hour (kWh) consumed by the data center. Default is the US average.
en.training-cost-tooltip: The computational cost per GPU per hour. The default value is based on Microsoft Azure V100 pay-as-you-go pricing.
en.training-co2-tooltip: Carbon emissions generated from electricity consumption during model training.
en.training-energy-tooltip: The total amount of electricity consumed by the data center during model training.
en.training-duration-tooltip: The total time required to complete model training.
en.training-cost-est-tooltip: The hardware rental cost required for model training (USD).
en.inf-tokens-tooltip: Default token counts based on common task types.
en.inf-total-params-tooltip: The total number of parameters in the model, in billions (B).
en.inf-base-params-tooltip: For MoE models, the number of parameters in the corresponding dense base model.
en.inf-power-tooltip: The average total power consumption per compute device, including host, memory, etc.
en.inf-efficiency-tooltip: The percentage of actual computational throughput relative to the theoretical peak throughput.
en.inf-pue-tooltip: Power Usage Effectiveness. The ratio of total data center energy consumption to IT equipment energy consumption. The closer to 1, the higher the efficiency.
en.inf-ci-tooltip: The grams of carbon dioxide equivalent produced per kilowatt-hour (kWh) consumed by the data center. Default is the US average.
en.inf-total-co2-tooltip: Total carbon emissions generated from electricity consumption during the model inference task.
en.inf-time-tooltip: The total time required to complete the inference.
en.inf-energy-tooltip: The total amount of electricity consumed by the data center during model inference.

zh.sub-title: 整合 LLM 訓練、推論及硬體生命週期的碳排計算
zh.lca-chip-model-label: 選擇 AI 晶片模型
zh.lca-lifespan-tooltip: AI 晶片在資料中心或伺服器環境中的典型運作壽命，通常為 5 年。
zh.lca-utilization-tooltip: AI 晶片在一天中進行訓練或推論任務的平均時間，建議值為 24 小時。
zh.lca-carbon-intensity-tooltip: 每產生一度電所產生的碳排放量。台灣 2022 年平均值約為 0.416 kgCO₂e/kWh。
zh.lca-total-co2-tooltip: 晶片在整個生命週期中產生的溫室氣體總排放量，包含製造與運作階段。
zh.lca-water-tooltip: 晶片在其使用壽命內，於製造及運作過程中消耗的總水量。
zh.lca-ewaste-tooltip: 晶片在生命週期結束後產生的廢棄物重量，通常指產品本身的重量。
zh.lca-op-co2-tooltip: 晶片在運作期間，因電力消耗所產生的碳排。
zh.lca-em-co2-tooltip: 晶片在製造、運輸及棄置階段所產生的碳排。
zh.training-total-params-tooltip: 模型的總參數數量，單位為十億 (Billion)。
zh.training-base-params-tooltip: 對於 MoE 模型，其對應的密集基礎模型參數數量。
zh.training-tokens-tooltip: 模型在訓練或推論過程中處理的 Token 總數，單位為十億 (Billion)。
zh.training-power-tooltip: 每台運算裝置（包含主機、記憶體等）的平均總功耗。
zh.training-efficiency-tooltip: 實際運算吞吐量相對於理論峰值吞吐量的百分比。
zh.training-pue-tooltip: 電力使用效率 (Power Usage Effectiveness)，資料中心總耗能與 IT 設備耗能的比值，越接近 1 效率越高。
zh.training-ci-tooltip: 資料中心每消耗一度電（kWh）所產生的二氧化碳當量(公斤)。預設值為美國平均。
zh.training-cost-tooltip: 單一 GPU 每小時的運算成本。預設值參考 Microsoft Azure V100 隨用隨付價格。
zh.training-co2-tooltip: 模型訓練期間，因電力消耗所產生的碳排。
zh.training-energy-tooltip: 模型訓練期間，資料中心總共消耗的電量。
zh.training-duration-tooltip: 模型完成訓練所需的總時間。
zh.training-cost-est-tooltip: 模型訓練期間所需的硬體租用成本 (USD)。
zh.inf-tokens-tooltip: 根據常見任務類型預設的 Token 數量。
zh.inf-total-params-tooltip: 模型的總參數數量，單位為十億 (Billion)。
zh.inf-base-params-tooltip: 對於 MoE 模型，其對應的密集基礎模型參數數量。
zh.inf-power-tooltip: 每台運算裝置（包含主機、記憶體等）的平均總功耗。
zh.inf-efficiency-tooltip: 實際運算吞吐量相對於理論峰值吞吐量的百分比。
zh.inf-pue-tooltip: 電力使用效率 (Power Usage Effectiveness)，資料中心總耗能與 IT 設備耗能的比值，越接近 1 效率越高。
zh.inf-ci-tooltip: 資料中心每消耗一度電（kWh）所產生的二氧化碳當量。預設值為美國平均。
zh.inf-total-co2-tooltip: 模型在推論任務中，因電力消耗所產生的總碳排。
zh.inf-time-tooltip: 模型完成推論所需的總時間。
zh.inf-energy-tooltip: 模型推論期間，資料中心總共消耗的電量。
